question.prompt:
What is the value of the following expression?

\[ \begin{aligned} &2(2(2(2(2(2+1)+1)\\ &\qquad{}+1)+1)+1)+1 \end{aligned} \]

solutions.title: Evaluate from the inside out
solutions.explanation:
Start with the innermost parentheses. Each surrounding layer then doubles the previous result and adds \(1\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
2+1&=3,\\
2(3)+1&=7,\\
2(7)+1&=15,\\
2(15)+1&=31,\\
2(31)+1&=63,\\
2(63)+1&=127.
\end{aligned}
\]
The value is \(\boxed{127}\), choice C.
